review_locator: PMCID:PMC5485854, TREM2-ligand interactions in health and disease
primary_title: TREM-2 binds to lipooligosaccharides of Neisseria gonorrhoeae and is expressed on reproductive tract epithelial cells
decision_basis: Exact gonococcal LOS binding is demonstrated by TREM2A-Fc far-western, ELISA and SPR, with transfected-cell signaling and human HeLa IL-6 support.
limitations_preserved: Preserve N. gonorrhoeae LOS, lipid-A acylation, TREM2A/transfected-cell and reporter/HeLa IL-6 context; no universal bacterial-ligand, SCI or terminal-TF inference.

primary_title: TREM2 is a receptor for non-glycosylated mycolic acids of mycobacteria that limits anti-mycobacterial macrophage activation
decision_basis: Exact fMA binding and TREM2-DAP12 reporter activation are supported by lipid ELISA, reporter and Trem2/Tyrobp-dependent macrophage assays.
limitations_preserved: Preserve non-glycosylated free-mycolic-acid preparation, plate-coated lipid, TREM2-DAP12 reporter and mycobacterial macrophage context; no generic mycobacterial-cell, SCI or terminal-TF inference.
